description: The ONE input pin of the vendored @insimul/core bundle (corebridge/vendor/core/). tools/vendor-core-bundle.mjs bundles core at exactly `coreCommit` (a `git archive` of that commit, never the checkout's working tree) with exactly `esbuild`, and --check refuses a VENDORED.json that records anything else. Bump both here, then re-vendor.
coreRefNote: P9a.native (2026-11-07, rulings U84 and U79(4)): the pin moved from b38e60d to core main f9aef13, which holds P9a.core (a4b3aaf..00fc64a: every registry genre activates its mechanics, a world's meta.enabledModules reaches the activation, the genre HUD view-model and its corpus conformance/ui/genre-hud-cases.json, the world rules panel and its corpus conformance/ui/rules-panel-cases.json, and the mechanic runtime assembly src/game-engine/mechanic-runtime.ts with its corpus conformance/modules/mechanic-runtime.json) that the ui.genreHud, ui.rulesPanel and mechanics.run rows run, and levels the vendored packs/ trees with core (U81). Before that, SP.composer-native (2026-11-05, rulings U62(1) and U79(4)): the pin moved from 4a46789 to core main b38e60d, which holds SP.composer's composer (4ca7e9e, src/system-packs/composer.ts) and its corpus (conformance/packs/composition.json, 34 cases, with the packs/ catalog it names) that the packs.compose row runs. Before that, L.native-layout (2026-10-29, ruling U36): the pin moved from c4b46c4 to core main 4a46789, which holds L1's layout rules (bdfe79d, src/editor/layout/) and B9's composition rules (5d05c18 onward, src/editor/layout/composition/) that the layout.* rows run. Before that, the C0 landing (2026-10-16) pinned c4b46c4. To move it again: bump coreCommit and coreRef here, re-vendor, re-run --check --core and the corebridge, layout, packs and P9a corpus ctests.
